verdict.rationale: The evidence shows one-time AML screening against lists described as 'constantly changing', and generic webhooks for applicant verification events. Nothing documents ongoing monitoring that re-screens previously verified applicants when watchlists update, or alerts raised specifically from such re-screening. Those are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on
